name: PT AEP Pinago Plantations Tbk
summary: PT AEP Pinago Plantations Tbk engages in the oil palm and rubber plantation business in Indonesia. The company specializes in the cultivation of oil palm and operates plantations and mills to produce crude palm oil and palm kernel. It also offers organic fertilizer and fruits. PT AEP Pinago Plantations Tbk was formerly known as PT PINAGO UTAMA Tbk and changed its name to PT AEP Pinago Plantations Tbk in July 2026. The company was founded in 1979 and is based in Jakarta Utara, Indonesia. As of May 4, 2026, PT AEP Pinago Plantations Tbk operates as a subsidiary of AEP Plantations Plc.
